schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS EVENT_DETAILS (ORG_ID CHAR(32) NOT NULL, CONFIG_KEY CHAR(32) NOT NULL, COMPONENT_NAME VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, REQUEST_ID CHAR(32) NOT NULL, UPDATE_DATE INT NOT NULL, UPDATE_TIME INT NOT NULL, CLIENT CHAR(16) NOT NULL, STATUS INT NOT NULL, EVENT_DATA VARCHAR(1024), MESSAGE VARCHAR(512), INSERTED_TIME TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, INDEX STATE_INDEX (UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_TIME, ORG_ID, CONFIG_KEY, COMPONENT_NAME, STATUS, CLIENT))
generation_sql: INSERT INTO EVENT_DETAILS (ORG_ID, CONFIG_KEY, COMPONENT_NAME, REQUEST_ID, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_TIME, CLIENT, STATUS, EVENT_DATA, MESSAGE) SELECT LPAD(FLOOR(RAND()*1000000), 32, '0'), LPAD(FLOOR(RAND()*1000000), 32, '0'), CONCAT('Component_', FLOOR(RAND()*100)), LPAD(FLOOR(RAND()*1000000), 32, '0'), FLOOR(RAND()*100000 + 20200000), FLOOR(RAND()*240000), LPAD(FLOOR(RAND()*10000), 16, '0'), FLOOR(RAND()*10), CONCAT('Event data ', FLOOR(RAND()*1000)), CONCAT('Message ', FLOOR(RAND()*1000)) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}
